title: Red Hat Security Advisory: qt5-qtbase security update
description: Two denial of service vulnerabilities have been identified in the Qt software toolkit's qt5-qtbase and qt6-qtbase packages. These issues involve uncontrolled recursion in XML serialization (CVE-2026-11573) and a denial of service vulnerability in XML parsing (CVE-2026-19248). Red Hat has issued security updates addressing these vulnerabilities in their Enterprise Linux 8.8 releases.
